name: Sceva
bio: Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, had seven sons who worked as itinerant exorcists; when they tried to cast out an evil spirit by invoking the name of the Lord Jesus as Paul preached him, the spirit answered that it did not know them, and the possessed man overpowered and beat them so badly they fled naked and wounded. The incident spread fear through Ephesus and magnified the name of the Lord Jesus (Acts 19:13-17).
